title: Algebraic data types
hints: README 'New syntax': one equation per constructor. For `largest`, add the two import lines shown in the README.

area/perimeter: match `(Circle r)`, `(Rect w h)`, `(Triangle a b c)` and use the formulas (Heron for the triangle area, with s in a where). next: three equations. largest: [] → Nothing, else Just the shape with the biggest area.
Other data: `worth (Coins n) = n` / `worth (Note v c) = v * c` · `maximumBy (comparing length) ["ab", "abcd"]` → "abcd".
`area (Triangle a b c) = sqrt (s * (s - a) * (s - b) * (s - c)) where s = (a + b + c) / 2` · `largest shapes = Just (maximumBy (comparing area) shapes)`.
